theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks combines high durability, full breadth, and an absolute trend gate that historically reduced drawdown for this market (gate_helps=true). Staying long benefits from the strong trend-following risk control, while crowding (z=1.17) only warrants cautious sizing, not a fade. No challenger has overtaken it yet; the broad rotation and macro fog do not disrupt the trend.
evidence: durability_bar=0.75, hurst_tag='trend' signal a persistent, well-structured uptrend
breadth=1.0 confirms all constituents are participating in the trend
eligible=true and gate_helps=true confirm the absolute trend gate has cut drawdown/shake-out risk for this market
rotation breadth=0.69 shows broad participation, but no alternative leader has higher durability/cohesion
theses.dissent: Crowding (z=1.17) elevates vulnerability to a sudden liquidity shift or risk-off event, which the high unscheduled macro share (1.0) could trigger. The trend gate only manages vol, not fundamental reversals—if credit or growth worries emerge, Banks could mean-revert sharply.

falsifier.text: Big Banks loses eligibility (trend gate flips ineligible) or its durability_bar drops below 0.6, indicating trend fragmentation.
